predecessors.name: Principality of Ryazan
predecessors.text: the same state's earlier Cliopatria row (Wikidata Q269109 is shared; the Wikipedia article covers 'Established: 1129' to 'Incorporation into Muscovy: 1521')

successors.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
successors.text: Cliopatria's Ryazan shape of 1519, the last: the Pronsk lands lie inside it

ledger.x: 1453: Ryazan, the grand principality on the middle Oka under Ivan III of Ryazan, is drawn again.
1483: Ryazan ends the separate Pronsk principality.
1521: Moscow absorbs the Principality of Ryazan, whole.
1521: the Grand Principality of Ryazan ends.

wars.name: Muscovite takeover of the Principality of Ryazan
wars.outcome: Vasili III summoned Ivan V of Ryazan to Moscow in 1517, captured and imprisoned him in 1520 and merged the principality with Muscovy in 1521; no battle is recorded on the pages opened.

certainty.note: No page gives a treaty or survey line: the Oka frontier with Moscow and the steppe frontier are approximate; Pronsk lies inside Ryazan's drawn shape.
